_about: The planning call. Holden Caulfield (CASE-021), investor profile 3, the only conservative client in the book. A third of his CHF 759k is idle cash and VZ Holding AG is 65.8% of the rest, driving all of its volatility and sitting above the product risk limit for his profile. He rings about small caps and finds that out. Lines and gaps are docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md, Call 2.

lines.text: Hello, it's Holden. I saw the news this morning, how much did today cost me?
That's less than I feared. Why did it barely move?
And how much of it is just sitting in cash doing nothing?
So is my portfolio too cautious, then?
I've been thinking about Swiss small caps. What about those?
Right. Call me before you change anything.
